svg.text: The grid's frequency is its balance meter: above 50 Hz more power is fed in than used (the spinning generators speed up), below it less. Primary control answers in seconds in
proportion to the deviation, like a P controller: 3000 MW across Continental Europe at ±200 mHz (hover: the implied power). Notice the regular spikes: they come at the quarter-hours
(next chart). Measured at one point (Freiburg), but the synchronous grid shares one frequency.
